benchmark.no_action_baseline: Holding cash earns 0% excess by construction; the null of zero net excess IS the do-nothing arm.
benchmark.primary: SPY 7-day return over the SAME scan timestamp
benchmark.rationale: Matching on the scan timestamp holds the interval fixed, so the difference is selection skill rather than a timing artifact.
benchmark.secondary_reference: raw (unadjusted) 7d return, reported alongside so the size of the drift correction is visible

evaluation.acceptance_rule: SUPPORTED only if the scan-clustered mean net excess return is > 0 AND the lower bound of its 95% CI is > 0. NOT_SUPPORTED if the mean is <= 0 or the CI includes 0. INCONCLUSIVE_SMALL_SAMPLE if fewer than 10 scans are eligible.
evaluation.clustering_rationale: Observations inside one scan share the same interval and are strongly cross-correlated; ~21 tickers per scan are close to one bet, not 21. Treating rows as independent would shrink the CI by roughly sqrt(21) and manufacture significance. The scan is the unit of independent observation, so N is ~20, not ~420.
known_limitations_declared_in_advance: ~20 scans over 20 calendar days is a very small sample; the CI will be wide and a null result will NOT prove the absence of skill.
Overlapping 7-day horizons across adjacent scans induce serial correlation that scan-clustering reduces but does not remove.
One market regime only; regime_label is degenerate ('neutral' in all 726 rows, a known upstream collapse), so no regime conditioning is attempted.
confidence_score spans only [0.835, 1.0], too narrow to calibrate.
Returns are unadjusted for corporate actions; over a 7-day window on these large-cap names the risk is small but not zero.
evaluation.primary_metric_definition: For each scan: mean over eligible tickers of (outcome_return_7d - SPY outcome_return_7d at that scan) minus friction. Then the mean across scans, with a 95% normal-approximation CI over the scan-level means.
evaluation.threshold_position: No effect size is required to 'pass'. This slice asks whether the effect is distinguishable from zero at all. A negative or null result is a successful execution of the experiment, not a failure of it.

evidence.missing_data_behavior: An unmatured or absent outcome is EXCLUDED, never imputed and never treated as zero. Exclusions are counted and reported.
evidence.revision_note: The file records one immutable observation per (ticker, scan); no restatement mechanism exists upstream, so vintage handling is NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_FIRST_SLICE rather than assumed correct.

friction.components: 5 bps entry + 5 bps exit (half-spread plus slippage)
friction.execution_delay: Assumed zero. The recorded price_at_signal is the price at the scan instant, and the outcome price is taken at the same daily granularity, so no intraday delay is modelled. This FLATTERS the strategy and is declared rather than hidden.
friction.rationale: Friction is charged to the signal arm only. The benchmark arm is buy-and-hold SPY over the same interval and incurs no round trip, which is the honest comparison: the do-nothing alternative does not trade.
friction.turnover: one round trip per signal; no netting across overlapping holds

hypothesis.null: Signals carry no skill beyond the market: the scan-clustered mean net excess return is zero or negative, and the raw win rate reflects broad drift over the window rather than selection.
hypothesis.primary: Signals carry skill beyond the market: the scan-clustered mean 7-day excess return over SPY, net of friction, is greater than zero.

leakage_controls.future_data_exclusion: Outcome snapshots carry known_at = evaluated_at_7d and are refused by the EvidenceGateway at any as_of before it.
leakage_controls.label_construction: The label is the upstream-recorded outcome_return_7d. This slice does not recompute it from prices and does not choose the exit.
leakage_controls.outcome_maturation: 286 of 726 rows had no matured 7d outcome and are excluded, not waited for and not imputed.
leakage_controls.pit_join: Signal and outcome are separate EvidenceSnapshots joined only by (ticker, scan); the outcome is never visible at signal as_of.
leakage_controls.survivorship: fixed recorded watchlist; no present-day re-query

reproducibility.code_identity: git commit of the candidate that executes the run
reproducibility.model_identity: NONE — no model is invoked. The signal scores were produced earlier by the live system and are read as recorded data.
reproducibility.random_seeds: NONE — the computation is fully deterministic

preregistration.research_question: Over the recorded 2026-05-12 to 2026-06-01 window, did StockBot's watchlist signals earn a positive 7-day return IN EXCESS OF SPY over the same interval, net of frozen friction -- or is the reported 60.7% raw win rate explained by market drift?

time.embargo_rule: An outcome may enter the computation only at an as_of at or after its evaluated_at_7d. Enforced by the EvidenceGateway, not by convention.
time.evaluation_horizon: 7 calendar days, as resolved upstream into outcome_return_7d
time.train_test_split: NONE. Nothing is fitted, so there is no parameter that could overfit and no split to leak across. The signal scores were produced live by the system before any outcome existed.

universe.definition: Every (ticker, scan) observation recorded in the evidence file whose 7-day outcome had matured, excluding the benchmark itself.
universe.eligible_entities: all non-SPY tickers present in the evidence file
excluded: SPY -- it is the benchmark and cannot be its own excess
rows whose scan has no matured SPY 7d return to difference against
universe.membership_semantics: Membership is fixed by the recorded file and is NOT reconstructed from a live universe, so survivorship cannot be introduced by re-querying a present-day ticker list. The window is 20 calendar days and no listed constituent was delisted within it.
universe.survivorship_note: The 22 tickers were selected by the live system BEFORE outcomes existed. This is a fixed watchlist, not a survivor-filtered one.
